info.title: Dubbing Platform API
info.description: Tenant-scoped dubbing pipeline (Tasks 006-013, frozen). Auth: JWT bearer with tid (tenant), sub (user), roles[] claims; SSE /progress/stream additionally accepts ?access_token= (same policy, short-TTL, never logged). Tenant isolation: cross-tenant ids return 404 (no existence leak), except project-scoped reads which return 403 and admin per-resource reads which return 404. Errors: every failure is { error: { code, message, correlationId, details } } with exactly one catalog code (see ErrorCode; mapping: validation 400, auth 401, forbidden 403, not-found 404 incl. cross-tenant, conflict 409, quota 429, provider 502/504, unknown 500 INTERNAL_ERROR with a generic message). Pagination is page-based: { items, page, pageSize, total, hasMore } (generic lists default 20/max 100; segments default 50/max 200; admin diagnostics default 50/max 200). Mutations accept Idempotency-Key (required on processing start, exports, review mutations, voice previews; same key+body replays with Idempotent-Replayed:true, same key+different body is 409). Concurrency: PATCH projects uses If-Match (settings version); segment selection and review mutations use expectedVersion bodies (stale is 409 with current version in details). SSE: GET .../progress/stream emits frozen SseEnvelope frames (14 event types, schemaVersion 1, allowlisted payload, Last-Event-ID resume with last-100 headers-only replay; hint only, HTTP APIs are source of truth).

patch.description: Strict patch: languages immutable (LANGUAGE_IMMUTABLE 400); processingSettings changes while a run is active are 409 SETTINGS_LOCKED_ACTIVE_RUN. Concurrency: send If-Match with the settings version (else settingsVersion body field); stale versions are 409 SETTINGS_VERSION_CONFLICT. Version bumps only on processingSettings change; hash recomputed.

Changed settings since the last run are 409 CONFIG_CHANGED_SINCE_RUN.

get.summary: Stream progress as frozen SSE envelopes
get.description: text/event-stream of SseEnvelope frames (eventType stage.progress, schemaVersion 1, allowlisted payload). Auth: Authorization Bearer or ?access_token= (same policy, short-TTL, never logged). Last-Event-ID resume replays missed envelope headers from the last-100 buffer (no payload backfill); replay beyond the window sets the replayTruncated:true response header and the client falls back to polling. Oversize payloads are dropped (counted in sse.payload_dropped_total); the stream stays open. Cross-tenant ids return 404. Frames are invalidation hints; GET .../progress is the source of truth.
Sections: project, media, run, phase, stage, progress{percentApproximate}, review, warnings[], output, cost, activity[<=10], permissions. Ten batched queries, ceiling 12.
Audit/activity summaries, newest first. Sanitized summaries only.
Failed/blocked counts plus distinct QC codes; never payload text.
Filters: speakerId, reviewStatus, qualityFlag, syncIssue, text (substring), startMs, endMs. Cross-tenant segment reads are 404; project mismatch is 403.
Detail plus transcript/translation versions and selection state. Cross-tenant ids return 404.

post.description: Requires the editor role. A retry already active is 409 SEGMENT_RETRY_ACTIVE. Idempotency-Key supported.
Body carries expectedVersion (selection version). Stale writes are 409 SELECTION_CONFLICT with { currentSelectionVersion, currentVersionIds } in details. Idempotency-Key supported.
Same concurrency contract as transcript selection: expectedVersion body, stale is 409 SELECTION_CONFLICT with current versions. Idempotency-Key supported.
HTML is stripped server-side; empty results are 400 SEGMENT_TEXT_EMPTY. Creates a manual version. Idempotency-Key supported.
Same contract as transcript edits: HTML stripped, blank is 400 SEGMENT_TEXT_EMPTY, manual version created. Idempotency-Key supported.

Returns { voices[], excludedCount, excluded[{ voiceId, reasons }] }. Excluded voices are never selectable; direct assignment returns 422 VOICE_INCOMPATIBLE.

put.summary: Assign a voice to a speaker
put.description: Project-stable assignment (latest run, else project pseudo-run; single-row invariant). Incompatible voices are 422 VOICE_INCOMPATIBLE; missing consent is 403 VOICE_CONSENT_REQUIRED; assigning the current voice returns 200 with changed:false. Idempotency-Key supported.

post.summary: Request a voice preview (202 first, 200 duplicate)
post.description: Fast-lane synthesis independent of final dub audio. Duplicate idempotency keys return the existing row (200, isDuplicate:true) without a second provider call. Quota exhaustion is 429 PREVIEW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED; invalid text is 400 PREVIEW_TEXT_INVALID. Idempotency-Key required.

Detail mints a 15-minute presigned download URL (null when the artifact is missing; never internal paths).
Open reviews oldest-first by default; versions/history capped at 50 with truncated flags.

post.description: Body carries expectedVersion (decision-row count) and a required reason (max 500, HTML stripped; blank is 400 REVIEW_REASON_REQUIRED). Stale versions are 409 REVIEW_VERSION_CONFLICT with { currentVersion }. Per-review idempotency (tenant, review-mutation:{id:N}, key, 24h); replay returns 200 with Idempotent-Replayed:true; same key with a different body is 409 CONFLICT.
Same concurrency/idempotency contract as resolve; records a Reject decision. Already-resolved items are 409 REVIEW_ALREADY_RESOLVED.

Bypasses the state machine via a conditional reopen (Requeue decision); reopening an open item is 409 REVIEW_ALREADY_RESOLVED semantics; resolving state errors use REVIEW_NOT_RESOLVED. Same idempotency contract as resolve. Never touches the run or publishes.

post.summary: Resolve with a manual edit (hardened, idempotent)
post.description: Same contract as resolve plus editText (HTML stripped; blank is 400 REVIEW_EDIT_EMPTY); creates a manual version. Same idempotency contract as resolve.

get.description: Shape { state Ready|Generating|Failed|Partial|Unavailable, generationState (alias of state), reason? (NO_RUNS_YET when no runs), completeness{ready,total}, progressApproximate? (Generating), errorCode? (Failed), items{video?,audio?,subtitles[],transcript?,translation?,timeline?,speakers?,qc{summary,issuesUrl?}} each with state+generationState, warnings[], updatedAt }. Signed URLs are 15-minute only, never storage keys. Cross-tenant aggregate reads are 404. Note: WorkspaceController exposes a same-path thin projection (paginated OutputAsset rows); the readiness aggregate pinned here is the authoritative output contract (Tasks 012/012A).
Returns a 200 JSON descriptor with the download URL (15-minute presigned). Incomplete outputs are 409 OUTPUT_INCOMPLETE.

post.summary: Create an export job (idempotent, 7-day key scope)
post.description: Body { format, profile? (normalized kebab, max 64, no traversal), allowPartial? }. Returns 202; replay of the same key+body returns the single row. Incomplete output without allowPartial is 409 EXPORT_INCOMPLETE/OUTPUT_INCOMPLETE with a partial offer. Idempotency-Key required.

200.description: Idempotent replay of the same key+body (Idempotent-Replayed:true header).

get.description: Newest first. Export retention surfaces via idempotency (7d).
Cross-tenant export ids return 404.
302 redirect to a 15-minute signed URL with an export.download audit. Not-ready jobs are 409 EXPORT_NOT_READY; expired URLs are 410 URL_EXPIRED.

Strict recipient scoping (TenantId + RecipientUserId == caller); expired rows excluded. ?unreadOnly=true filters unread. Payloads carry short summaries only. Deep links (resourceType/resourceId/projectId) route the frontend; when the linked row is gone, fall back to projectId then the list. notification.created SSE is a hint only; this API is the source of truth.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key for safe retries. Required on processing start (24h scope), export create (7d), review mutations (24h per-review scope), and voice preview requests. Same key+body replays (200 + Idempotent-Replayed:true); same key+different body is 409. Auth (/auth/*) and identity (/me*) routes never take this header.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Expected settings version for PATCH /projects/{projectId} (optimistic concurrency; alternative to the settingsVersion body field). Stale versions are 409 SETTINGS_VERSION_CONFLICT.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Resume cursor for the SSE stream. Missed envelope headers replay from the last-100 buffer; replay beyond the window sets replayTruncated:true and the client falls back to polling.

AccessToken.name: access_token
AccessToken.description: Short-TTL bearer for /progress/stream only (EventSource cannot set headers). Same policy as Authorization; never logged.

ErrorCode.description: Frozen public error-code catalog (65 codes). Status mapping: VALIDATION_FAILED 400, UNAUTHORIZED/INVALID_CREDENTIALS/TOKEN_EXPIRED/TOKEN_REUSED 401, FORBIDDEN/CONSENT_REQUIRED/POLICY_DENIED/USER_DISABLED/VOICE_CONSENT_REQUIRED 403, NOT_FOUND/PROJECT_NOT_FOUND/VERSION_NOT_FOUND/VOICE_NOT_FOUND/ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE 404, MEDIA_UNSUPPORTED 415, MEDIA_CORRUPT/QC_BLOCKED/ARTIFACT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH/VOICE_INCOMPATIBLE/IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED 422, PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED/PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED/RATE_LIMITED 429, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED/STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE 503, PROVIDER_TIMEOUT 504, PROVIDER_INVALID_RESPONSE/PROVIDER_FAILED 502, PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_ERROR/PIPELINE_INVARIANT_VIOLATION/INTERNAL_ERROR 500, PREFERENCE_VALUE_TOO_LARGE 413, URL_EXPIRED 410, all other *_CONFLICT/*_ACTIVE/*_LOCKED/SELECTION_CONFLICT/LEASE_LOST/MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED/EXPORT_NOT_READY/EXPORT_INCOMPLETE/OUTPUT_INCOMPLETE/SEGMENT_RETRY_ACTIVE/REVIEW_*_RESOLVED 409, UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE/LANGUAGE_IMMUTABLE/VERSION_SEGMENT_MISMATCH/SEGMENT_TEXT_EMPTY/PREVIEW_TEXT_INVALID/REVIEW_REASON_REQUIRED/REVIEW_EDIT_EMPTY/PREFERENCE_KEY_UNKNOWN/IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED/DUPLICATE_MEDIA 400-or-409 per catalog, TENANT_REQUIRED 401.

ErrorResponse.description: Uniform error envelope: { error: { code, message, correlationId, details } }. details carries field errors only; 500s carry a generic message.

PaginatedResult.description: Page-based list envelope: { items, page, pageSize, total, hasMore }. hasMore is page * pageSize < total.
